gbm_population_evidence.quote: Glioblastoma; GBM; Glioblastoma Multiforme; Grade IV Astrocytoma
Have histologically confirmed World Health Organization Grade IV IDH wildtype glioblastoma or variants including gliosarcoma or IDH wildtype glioma with molecularly features of glioblastoma.

candidate_evidence.quote: Group A receives nivolumab plus ipilimumab
Both nivolumab and ipilimumab are antibodies (types of human protein) that work to stop tumor cells from growing and multiplying by immunotherapy.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Be at first or second relapse.
Surgical Nivolumab And Ipilimumab For Recurrent GBM

role_evidence.quote: One dose of nivolumab plus ipilimumab will be administered 14(±5) days before surgery.

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: work to stop tumor cells from growing and multiplying by immunotherapy

role_evidence.quote: After surgery, participants receive nivolumab in combination with ipilimumab every 3 weeks for 9 weeks and then nivolumab alone every 4 weeks.

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: work to stop tumor cells from growing and multiplying by immunotherapy

role_evidence.quote: Intravenous (IV) solution that has no therapeutic effect, used as a control in testing investigational drug. One dose is received prior to surgery.
Group B receives nivolumab plus placebo-ipilimumab
Subjects also have the option of undergoing Zr-89 Crefmirlimab berdoxam PET scans.

agents.drug_class_hint: zirconium-89-labelled anti-CD8 minibody PET imaging agent (optional sub-study)

biomarkers.biomarker_other: cell cycle-related genetic signature in tumour microenvironment (multiplex IHC)

source_quote.quote: Multiplex IHC staining will be performed on tumor tissue to evaluate the influence of the neoadjuvant administration on the cell cycle-related genetic signature within the tumor microenvironment of recurrent glioblastoma.

coder_notes: Randomised three-arm neoadjuvant window trial; all arms labelled EXPERIMENTAL, but Group C (placebo-nivolumab plus placebo-ipilimumab before surgery) functions as the control for the primary TIL-density comparison, hence control_arm_from_other_arms yes. All arms receive nivolumab plus ipilimumab after surgery. Placebos listed as control_comparator with moiety 'placebo'. Zr-89 crefmirlimab berdoxam is an optional CD8 PET imaging agent (diagnostic). IDH row is the exclusion of IDH-mutant tumours that defines IDH-wildtype GBM. TIL density (primary outcome) is an immune-cell measure, not recorded as a molecular biomarker. Bristol-Myers Squibb is a collaborator (captured by [CODE]); no text on drug supply.
